title: CLAUDE.md exists
rationale: Agents start every session without memory; the file is how a project teaches its rules.

title: CLAUDE.md stays short
rationale: Long instruction files are skimmed; invariants get lost. Link to details instead of inlining them.
hint: Move reference material to docs/ and import it with @path.

title: CLAUDE.md lists the commands to verify work
rationale: An agent that cannot run the gates cannot honestly claim to be done.

title: CLAUDE.md states hard invariants
rationale: Rules that must never be broken belong in one place the agent reads first.

title: CLAUDE.md requires test-first work
rationale: Red, green, refactor keeps agent-written code honest and small.

title: CLAUDE.md defines when a task is done
rationale: Without a definition of done, agents stop at "compiles".

title: Claude Code settings are committed
rationale: Shared permissions and hooks make agent behaviour reproducible for everyone.

title: Repeated workflows are slash commands
rationale: A written /tdd or /verify command is cheaper and safer than re-explaining the workflow.
